name: Kron's Amulet
summary: Kron's Amulet is a recovered personal keepsake belonging to Kron, a young orc hunter from Durotar. It serves as the sole physical proof of his grim fate along the banks of the Southfury River.

sections.title: Tragedy on the Southfury
sections.body: Kron was a headstrong young orc from a farmstead northwest of Razor Hill. Eager to prove his prowess and dismissive of danger, he stormed off to hunt the vicious Dreadmaw crocolisks prowling the Southfury River along the border with the Barrens. Ignoring his mother Misha Tor'kren's warnings, his stubborn pride led him directly into the jaws of the river's predators. He never returned, leaving behind only this swallowed trinket as a silent confirmation that he had been slain and devoured.

faq.answer: Kron was an impulsive young orc hunter who lived with his mother, Misha Tor'kren, on a farmstead northwest of Razor Hill. Determined to test his strength, he went out alone to hunt river beasts despite warnings of their ferocity.

aliases: where do i find the amulet
faq.answer: The amulet is recovered from the bellies of Dreadmaw Crocolisks and Corrupted Dreadmaw Crocolisks lurking along the banks of the Southfury River in Durotar.

aliases: where to turn in kron's amulet
faq.answer: His grieving mother, Misha Tor'kren, awaits word of her son at her farmstead northwest of Razor Hill. The amulet provides her the final, painful closure needed to begin mourning.

angles.text: Kron's fate is a tragic reminder that while pride and martial glory drive orcish tradition, recklessness and ignoring the wisdom of elders can bring a swift and needless death.
A stark lesson for any aspiring tracker on the perils of underestimating vicious beasts in unfamiliar river territory.
